subject: SprintGate - quota advisory and traffic model alignment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@fastcart.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch window and temporary quota uplift request

Hi Avery,

Quick summary: FastCart is planning a feature-gated campaign (SprintGate) that will roll out to ~35% of our active US users over a 48-hour window starting Nov 10. Early simulations show a baseline 6x increase in inference requests during the first 6 hours of the rollout, with a 2x sustained bump for the remainder of week 1. We need guidance on a short-term quota/rate uplift and any product-level mitigations you recommend (caching, fallback models, token limits).

Attached is our launch plan and expected traffic profile (fastcart-launch-plan.pdf). Can Redwood provision a temporary per-minute and per-user token allowance, and advise on routing policies for a canary? Also need an estimate of expected cost delta for the uplift — procurement will ask.

Happy to jump on a short sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior PM, Integrations — FastCart
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fastcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window and temporary quota uplift request

Thanks Elena — this is helpful. Looping in Monica (CS) and Karthik (inference/product) to scope the lift and technical mitigations.

Quick clarifying questions:
- Is the 6x spike concentrated in a 1–2 hour flash or spread evenly over 6 hours?
- Any heavy long-context prompts (seq > 2k) expected from the feature?
- Do you have a preferred canary cohort size (we recommend 5–10% first) and a rollback SLT?

Product asks from my side: can you add a short section in the plan that lists prompt examples and percentile token lengths (p50/p95)? That helps Karthik pick a quantization/profile and batching policy.

Propose a 30-minute call today at 3:00 PM PT if that works — otherwise tomorrow morning.

Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fastcart.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window and temporary quota uplift request

Elena / Avery — thanks for the context. A few commercial notes:
- We can do a time-boxed uplift (30-day window) scoped to per-minute and per-tenant QPS. Finance will need an estimated token-based uplift cost; Elena, if you can share the projected token volume for the first 48 hours that helps.
- To expedite approvals, please confirm the contract amendment path: a PO + email approval should suffice for temporary uplifts under $50k. Anything above will need director approval.

Referenced DocuSign (if you want pre-authorized temporary uplift): https://app.docusign.com/fastcart-temp-uplift

I'll also coordinate billing contacts and the invoice cadence once we have final numbers.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@fastcart.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window and temporary quota uplift request

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Elena — this is helpful. Looping in Monica (CS) and Karthik (inference/product) to scope the lift and technical mitigations.

Thanks for the details — ran a quick model/throughput back-of-envelope against the plan. Initial read:
- If the 6x spike is a short flash (1–2h) we can absorb ~3x with autoscaling + batching; beyond that we should provision a temporary quota uplift.
- Recommend the following temporary configuration for the Nov 10 window:
  * Per-tenant rate: increase from 120 reqs/min -> 400 reqs/min (conservative headroom for 6x flash)
  * Token throttle: soft token cap per request = 12k tokens, global minute token cap increased by 3x
  * Canary: 7% cohort with automatic rollback after 5% error-rate delta vs baseline for 10 minutes
  * Routing: prefer lower-cost model variant for background/async events, keep high-quality model for foreground UI flows

Operational mitigations: enable prefix KV caching for the most common prompt prefixes (we can preload KV for the canary cohort). Also suggest reducing max response length by 10–20% for non-critical flows to lower token spend.

I'll put a short playbook in the shared drive with exact endpoint names and the API keys to toggle policies: https://drive.redwood.local/teams/sales/fastcart/sprintgate-plan (pending access).

-Karthik
Principal Product Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@fastcart.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window and temporary quota uplift request

Thanks everyone — operational confirmation and next steps.

We will provision a scoped temporary uplift under ticket #8421: quota-increase-ticket-8421.pdf attached. Summary of what we will set on Nov 10 00:00 PT (48-hour window):
- Per-tenant request rate: 400 reqs/min (from 120)
- Global minute token cap multiplied by 3x for the tenant
- Canary cohort controls as Karthik specified (7% cohort, auto-rollback triggers configured)

Timeline: provisioning completed by Nov 9 20:00 PT; canary activated Nov 10 00:00 PT; full cohort ramp to 35% by Nov 10 02:00 PT if metrics stable.

We've attached a short ramp playbook (ramp-playbook.md) and the ticket PDF. Monica: I noted the commercial threshold ($50k) for auto-approval — I will mark the ticket as requiring director approval only if projected uplift cost exceeds that.

Next steps:
- Elena: please share the p50/p95 token lengths and the final token volume estimate (Elena requested) by Fri EOD (Oct 24).
- Monica: please attach PO or pre-approval link if FastCart wants DocuSign pre-auth.
- Avery/Karthik: join the operations pre-launch dry run on Nov 8 10:00 PT (invite to follow).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Traffic Ops Lead — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: quota-increase-ticket-8421.pdf, ramp-playbook.md
